svg.title: RescuePulse TDOA direction-of-arrival estimate
svg.desc: Three neon zones explain how RescuePulse decides where a siren is. On the left a top-down scene shows two microphones on a bar with a siren source and expanding wavefronts. In the centre a sixty-five bin cross-correlation histogram shows the delay peak with a shaded plus-or-minus-two dead zone at zero. On the right a verdict card states the decision rule. Over twelve seconds the wavefronts arrive from the left, then head on, then from the right; the correlation peak snaps between bin 28, bin 31 and bin 37; the rings pulse outward; and the verdict chip steps through amber source left, green source centre and red source right.
svg.text: ESP-DSP dsps_corr_f32 · 65 LAG BINS · ±32 SAMPLES @ 16 kHz · DEAD ZONE ±2
Δt = d · sinθ / c · c ≈ 343 m/s
3 SEGMENTS AVERAGED AT 25 / 50 / 75 % OF THE BLOCK
